copy.curiosityHook: With Camelot facing total conquest by Ruber, can one brave girl honor her father's legacy in time to save Arthur's crown?
copy.description: In King Arthur's realm, spirited Kayley longs to become a Knight of the Round Table like her late father. When the ruthless Ruber moves to invade Camelot and claim the throne, she must step up to protect the kingdom.
copy.vibeSummary: Exciting animated fantasy with steady momentum and heartfelt stakes, well suited for engaged family viewing.
copy.whyWatch: Director Frederik Du Chau delivers an animated Arthurian adventure blending high-stakes fantasy conflict with genuine heart, ideal for an engaging family movie night.

allowedMaterial: Setting in the times of King Arthur
Kayley's goal of becoming a Knight of the Round Table like her late father
Ruber's plot to invade Camelot and take the throne
excludedMaterial: Fate of King Arthur or Camelot
Specific late-stage character arcs or revelations
